path_step: User receives chat messages from another participant
test_scenario: Verify that a user (Teacher or Student) can successfully receive chat messages from another participant in a live video session.
test_case_title: Verify user can receive chat messages
pre_condition: Both Teacher and Student are logged in, enrolled in the course, and have joined an active video session.
expected_result: Both Teacher and Student are able to see messages sent by the other party in the chat interface.
post_condition: Chat messages are displayed in the chat interface for both sender and receiver.

test_steps.step: Teacher verifies receipt of the message in the chat interface.
Student verifies receipt of the message in the chat interface.

uncovered_conditions: Normal Flow: Common Action 2 (User can receive messages in the chat)
